decisions.reason: Direct insertion of the supplied biographies does not change the required section order or the prohibition on reordering.
The source concerns biographies and does not change incorporation of the organization chart.
The Tables document is only the location where the biographies were supplied; the source does not alter the proposal tables or their replacements.
Biography handling is owned by the separate biography-integration Requirement and does not modify the standing rule to include supplied narrative content.
Adding biographies may affect layout effort, but the source does not change the page-count target or compliance goal.
The biography insertion method does not change whether a table of contents must be included.
The supplied biographies do not change the Agua Arc identity, colors, or logo requirements.
The source concerns biography text rather than required photographs or their selection rule.
Directly inserting biographies into the current proposal does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template Requirement.
The biography update does not alter Canva ownership, editability, asset restrictions, or source-deliverable terms.
The biographies add content to be handled under their own Requirement but do not change the established full-document layout or graphic-treatment rules.
The source does not mention hyperlinks or change the requirement that proposal links remain functional.
